include { MIRTOP_GFF        } from 'nf-core/mirtop/gff'
include { MIRTOP_COUNTS     } from 'nf-core/mirtop/counts'
include { MIRTOP_EXPORT     } from 'nf-core/mirtop/export'
include { MIRTOP_STATS      } from 'nf-core/mirtop/stats'


workflow BAM_STATS_MIRNA_MIRTOP {

    take:
    ch_bam          // channel: [ val(meta), [ bam ] ]
    ch_hairpin      // channel: [ val(meta), [ hairpin ] ]
    ch_gtf_species  // channel: [ val(meta), [ gtf ], val(species) ]

    main:

    MIRTOP_GFF ( ch_bam, ch_hairpin, ch_gtf_species )

    MIRTOP_COUNTS ( MIRTOP_GFF.out.gff, ch_hairpin, ch_gtf_species )

    MIRTOP_EXPORT ( MIRTOP_GFF.out.gff, ch_hairpin, ch_gtf_species )

    MIRTOP_STATS ( MIRTOP_GFF.out.gff )

    emit:
    gff            = MIRTOP_GFF.out.gff                     // channel: [ val(meta), [ gff ] ]
    isomirs        = MIRTOP_EXPORT.out.tsv                  // channel: [ val(meta), [ tsv ] ]
    counts         = MIRTOP_COUNTS.out.tsv                  // channel: [ val(meta), [ tsv ] ]
    stats_txt      = MIRTOP_STATS.out.txt                   // channel: [ val(meta), [ txt ] ]
    stats_log      = MIRTOP_STATS.out.log                   // channel: [ val(meta), [ log ] ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_stats_mirna_mirtop"
description: "mirtop is a command line tool to annotate miRNAs and isomiRs and compute\
  \ general statistics using the mirGFF3 format."
keywords:
- "miRNA"
- "isomirs"
- "bam"
- "stats"
components:
- "mirtop/gff"
- "mirtop/counts"
- "mirtop/export"
- "mirtop/stats"
input:
- ch_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the BAM/CRAM/SAM files\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam/cram/sam}"
- ch_hairpin:
    type: "file"
    description: "Input channel containing the hairpin fasta file\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa}"
- ch_gtf_species:
    type: "file"
    description: "Input channel containing the species gtf and the name of species\
      \ in miRbase format\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(gtf), val(species)]\n"
    pattern: "*.{gtf}"
output:
- gff:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the mirGFF3 files with the annotated miRNAs and\
      \ isomiRs\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(gff) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gff"
- isomirs:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing isomiRs compatible files\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- counts:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing TSV files with the miRNA and isomiR counts per\
      \ sample\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- stats_txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing TXT file with a table with different statistics\
      \ for each type of isomiRs: total counts, average counts, total sequences.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- stats_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing log files in JSON format with the same information\
      \ as stats_txt\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
authors:
- "@atrigila"
maintainers:
- "@atrigila"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/mirtop/gff@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/mirtop/counts@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/mirtop/export@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/mirtop/stats@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
